map.基本通行能力 C₀ 由道路类型与设计速度查表（高速 100km/h 单车道 22: Basic capacity C₀ comes from a table by road type and design speed (a 100 km/h highway single lane is 2200 pcu/h), multiplied by lane count N for the section's basic capacity.
map.经车道宽度 f_w、大型车 f_HV=1/[1+PT(ET−1)]、驾驶员 f_: Applying lane-width f_w, heavy-vehicle f_HV=1/[1+PT(ET−1)] and driver f_p corrections gives possible capacity C, and multiplying by the design V/C (0.7 for class C) gives the design capacity.
map.输入实际流量 q，算饱和度 V/C = q/C，对照 LOS 分级（A<0.35: Enter the actual flow q to get V/C = q/C and compare against LOS grades (A<0.35 free flow … E≥1.0 congested) to judge the service level; V/C>0.85 requires expansion.
map.可复现算例（高速 双车道 V=100, 3.5m, cl=1.5, PT=15%: Reproducible example (highway, two lanes, V=100, 3.5 m, cl=1.5, PT=15%, ET=2.0, q=2520)
map.：基本能力 C₀×N = 2200×2 = 4400 pcu/h。\n车道宽修正:
: basic capacity C₀×N = 2200×2 = 4400 pcu/h.
lane-width correction f_w = 0.97(3.5m)×1.0(side clearance≥1.5m) = 0.97.
heavy-vehicle correction f_HV = 1/[1+0.15×(2.0−1)] = 1/1.15 ≈ 0.870.
possible capacity C = 4400×0.97×0.870×1.0 ≈ 3711 pcu/h.
design capacity = 3711×0.7 ≈ 2598 pcu/h (class C).
saturation V/C = 2520/3711 ≈ 0.679 → LOS C (stable flow), and 0.679≤0.85 meets the design requirement.
map.pcu = 标准小客车当量，把大型车、摩托车等按占用空间折算成小客车数。大型车占: pcu = passenger car unit, converting large vehicles and motorcycles into an equivalent number of cars by space occupancy. The higher the heavy-vehicle proportion PT and conversion factor ET, the smaller f_HV and the lower the capacity, so multi-lane highways must account for vehicle mix.
map.服务水平（Level of Service）用饱和度 V/C 划分：A 自由流畅: Level of Service is graded by saturation V/C: A free flow, B/C stable, D approaching unstable, E congested, F forced-flow congestion (V/C≥1). Design generally requires no worse than C~D, i.e. V/C within 0.7~0.85.
map.计算道路基本、可能与设计通行能力，按 V/C 饱和度评估服务水平（LOS），并考: Computes basic, possible and design capacity of a road, evaluates level of service (LOS) by V/C saturation, and considers correction factors for lanes and heavy vehicles, supporting traffic planning.
